name: legacy-monolith-decomposition
title: Decompose the 12.9k-line legacy.py monolith
description: legacy.py is ~12,919 lines in one file (16x the repo's own 800-line cap); the combine/models/otel/scenarios/schema facades are 7-line re-exports, not real splits. Every change lands in one file and the lint/checklist governance compensates for the structural debt. Plan and execute an incremental, byte-identical-output-preserving decomposition into focused modules.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Epic in progress: design.md fixed the boundaries; step 1 (redaction.py + package-aware test loaders) shipped in PR #178 with all locked golden hashes unchanged. Steps 2-10 are the nine 07-02-decomp-* child tasks, sequenced leaf-first; the RNG-critical generation/topology core is last. | FOLLOW-UP (cosmetic, from step 5 / PR #185): _EMIT_ARTIFACT_FILES now sits under the `# Combine step` section header in legacy.py after the combine writers moved to combine_impl.py — the header is misleading since the constant is a core emit registry, not combine-specific (a comment clarifies it stays). Relabel or move the constant above the header when a later decomp step (likely catalog-data) next reorganizes that region; too small for its own PR.
